title: Day and night
examples: Teacher, why do we have day and night?
Does the sun move around the Earth?
What makes it dark when the sun goes down?

explain.say: The Earth is always spinning around. This spinning motion is called rotation. It takes one whole day for Earth to spin once.
The Sun is a giant ball of hot light. It stays in one place while the Earth spins past it. The Sun does not move across the sky.
When your part of Earth faces the Sun, it is daytime. You can see the bright light from the Sun. This is when we play outside.
When your part of Earth spins away from the Sun, it is nighttime. The dark side cannot see the Sun's light. We sleep during this time.

faq.q: Why does the day and night happen?
faq.a: It happens because the Earth is constantly spinning. As it spins, different parts face the Sun at different times. You might also ask, 'What causes day and night?' or 'Why is it dark sometimes?'

faq.q: Does the Sun move across the sky?
faq.a: No, the Sun stays in one place. It is actually the Earth that is spinning around the Sun. You could also ask, 'Does the Sun travel across the sky?' or 'Is the Sun moving?'
asks: Does the Sun travel across the sky?

faq.q: What is the spinning motion called?
faq.a: The spinning motion of the Earth is called rotation. This spinning takes one full day to complete. You might also ask, 'What is the Earth doing?' or 'How does the Earth move?'

faq.q: What happens when the Earth spins?
faq.a: When the Earth spins, some parts get light from the Sun and some parts get dark. This makes the cycle of day and night. You could also ask, 'What is the result of spinning?' or 'How does spinning affect us?'
asks: What is the result of spinning?

faq.q: Is the Sun moving around the Earth?
faq.a: No, the Sun is not moving around the Earth. The Earth is spinning around itself, which causes the day and night cycle. You might also ask, 'Does Earth orbit the Sun?' or 'Where is the Sun in relation to Earth?'
asks: Where is the Sun in relation to Earth?

facts: The Earth spins on an imaginary line.
This spinning motion is called rotation.
It takes one full day for Earth to spin once.
Day happens when Earth faces the Sun.

quiz.say: The day and night cycle is caused by:

options.show: The Sun moving across the sky
options.say: The Sun moving across the sky

quiz.why: The Earth spinning is the reason different parts get light and dark.

wrong.0: The Moon does not cause the day and night cycle.
wrong.1: Orbiting is a different movement than spinning.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the Sun stays in one place.

quiz.say: When a part of Earth faces the Sun, it is:
quiz.why: Daytime happens when the Sun's light hits that part of Earth.

wrong.0: This word describes a different type of movement.
wrong.2: Nighttime is when the Earth faces away from the Sun.
wrong.3: Twilight is only a short time, not the whole period.

quiz.say: If the Earth stops spinning, what would happen?

options.show: There would be no day or night
options.say: There would be no day or night

quiz.why: Without spinning, the light would hit one side constantly, never changing.

wrong.0: The Sun shining is not related to Earth's spin.
wrong.1: The Earth still has light, just not in a cycle.
wrong.2: Stopping the spin would cause other problems, but not flying away.
